skins.name: Magician of Passion
skins.content: Ave Mujica Collaborative Series/Magician of Passion. Tolling her decision, this stage costume is made manifest in the realm of dreams. For as easily as she will scry your hearts, so one can scarcely scry hers.
skins.usage: One of Nyamu Yūtenji's Terran stage costumes.
skins.quote: Risking her all, she confronts that which she loves.
